## Summary

The change is implemented in the owner create endpoint (`POST /api/owners`), handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`.

I added a dedicated SLF4J logger named `AUDIT`:

```java
private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");
```

and emit an audit line immediately after the owner is successfully persisted (so `owner.getId()` is populated), carrying the three required fields:

```java
this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);
AUDIT.info("owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}",
    owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate());
```

This satisfies the spec: on successful create the `AUDIT` logger records a line containing the owner id, the `customerCode`, and the `registrationDate`. The `AcceptanceTest.coreLogsAuditOnCreate` test — which captures the `AUDIT` logger and asserts a single message contains all three values from the created/fetched owner — passes, and the full suite (260 tests) is green.
